args.name: bockstein
args.statement: forall C:cx, p n r:int, a:el: fintype(C) and prime(p) and 0 <= n and 1 <= r and a in H(C,n) and zsummand(a,H(C,n)) -> Zr(bock(C,p),r,j(bock(C,p),a)) and dzero(bock(C,p),r,j(bock(C,p),a)) and not dimg(bock(C,p),r,n-1,j(bock(C,p),a))

args.name: zp
args.statement: forall C:cx, p n r:int, a:el: fintype(C) and prime(p) and 1 <= r and a in H(C,n) and zpksummand(a,H(C,n),p,1) -> not dimg(bock(C,p),r,n-1,j(bock(C,p),a))
